descriptions.messages: Private conversations, the company chat, team chats and groups
descriptions.groupChats: Every group conversation: members, admins, lock and delete

chat.title: Messages
chat.newMessageHint: Choose a colleague. If you already have a conversation with them, it opens.
chat.newGroupHint: Give the group a name and add at least two colleagues. You will be its admin.
chat.noConversationsHint: Start one with a colleague, or create a group.
chat.searchPeople: Search colleagues by name or e-mail
chat.groupMinimum: {count} members with you. A group needs at least {minimum}.
chat.pickConversationHint: Your private chats, the company chat, team chats and groups are on the left.
chat.conversationClosed: That conversation is no longer available to you.
chat.historyStart: This is the start of the conversation.
chat.deleteBody: It is removed for everyone in the conversation. They will see that a message was deleted.
chat.lockedNotice: This group has been locked by an administrator. You can still view previous messages.
chat.inactiveNotice: This team chat is inactive: its team has fewer than three members. You can still read previous messages.
chat.adminOnlyNotice: Only admins can send messages in this group.

search.title: Search this conversation
search.hint: Type at least two characters. Only this conversation is searched.

details.title: Details
details.adminOnlyHint: Members can still read every message.
details.adminOnlyOnBody: Members keep reading and receiving messages, but only admins can send.
details.adminOnlyOffBody: Every member can send messages again.
details.teamMembersHint: Team chat members follow the team: they change when the team does.
details.minimumHint: A group needs at least three members — add someone before removing anyone.
details.addMembersHint: Only colleagues who can join groups are offered.
details.makeAdminBody: Admins add and remove people, rename the group and choose who can send.
details.removeAdminBody: They stay in the group as a member.
details.removeBody: They lose access to the group and its messages.

chats.title: Group chats
chats.subtitle: The company chat, team chats and custom groups — their members, admins and settings.
chats.privacy: Messages are private to each conversation's members. Administrators see group details and can lock or delete groups, but never read messages.
chats.emptyFiltered: No group chat matches these filters.
chats.lockBody: Nobody can send messages while it is locked — its admins included.
chats.lockDetailRead: Members can still read the previous messages.
chats.lockDetailNotify: Members are told it was locked.
chats.deleteBody: The group disappears for all its members and its messages are deleted.
chats.deleteDetailMembers: {count} members lose access at once and are told.
chats.deleteDetailMessages: All its messages are deleted permanently.
chats.detailsHint: Members, admins and settings. Messages are not available here.

errors.chatAdminOnly: Only the group's admins can send messages right now.
errors.chatCannotRemoveSelf: You can't remove yourself from a group you run.
errors.chatInactive: This team chat is inactive until its team has three members again.
errors.chatLastAdmin: A group needs at least one admin.
errors.chatLocked: This group is locked by an administrator.
errors.chatMaximumMembers: That would make the group too large.
errors.chatMemberNotEligible: One of those people can't be added to groups.
errors.chatMessageDeleted: This message was deleted, so it can't be edited.
errors.chatMessageNotDeletable: Only the sender can delete a message.
errors.chatMessageNotEditable: Only the sender can edit a message.
errors.chatMinimumMembers: A group needs at least three members.
errors.chatNotEligible: Administrators manage groups but don't take part in them.
errors.chatNotGroupAdmin: Only the group's admins can do that.
errors.chatNotManageable: This conversation can't be changed that way.
errors.chatRateLimited: You're sending too fast — wait a moment.
